text:
Priya: Heads-up — the onboarding sample-app is a little too parallel by default. It fires 12 concurrent page fetches and we've seen customers hit 429s and weird missing items.

Jonah: oof. is this the pagination helper in samples or the SDK helper?

Priya: samples. code is literally: 

```
const pages = [...Array(12).keys()];
await Promise.all(pages.map(p => client.listItems({page: p})))
```

When pages 4/5 return 429 for a bit the Promise.all fails and we bail out. The SDK retry middleware retries each request independently, which amplifies the burst.

Kim: that pattern is a footgun. SDK should expose a simple concurrency option and samples should demonstrate a safe pattern (sequential or limited concurrency).

Rui: server side we can emit Retry-After for short failures but we still need clients to respect it. Also note auth refresh interrupts a retry flow today: if refresh happens mid-retry the other inflight retries may succeed with old token and get rejected, causing inconsistent cursors.

Jonah: SDK parity note: Python client has a "throttle" arg (token-bucket + concurrency). JS missing that. We should add: client.options = { concurrency: 4, tokenBucket: { rate: 10 }, respectRetryAfter: true } with defaults matching python.

Priya: For samples I suggest changing example to use p-limit and show backoff helper: 

```
const limit = pLimit(4)
await Promise.all(pages.map(p => limit(() => client.listItems({page: p}))))
```

and a small comment about respectRetryAfter.

Kim: Can we also make SDK treat 429 as retryable in the paginated helper instead of bubbling as fatal? Preserve cursor and retry up to N times before giving up.

Jonah: yes. plan: 1) change paginated helper to maintain per-page state + retryable errors; 2) add concurrency + token-bucket to JS SDK; 3) update sample-app and quickstart. I'll draft PRs.

Rui: I'll add Retry-After where we can. Also we'll add an SLO dashboard for sustained 429 spikes so we can detect client-side misbehavior.

Priya: filing a small DX issue for sample-app and doc note: https://redwood-internal/issues/5301 — tagging onboarding and docs.

deploy-bot: queued pipeline for jonah/sdk-paginate-retries (sha: d4f567)

Kim: test plan: local mock that returns 429 on pages with odd ids for the first 2 attempts, assert no items lost and sample-app still completes. Add to e2e flaky matrix.

Jonah: adding unit tests for token-bucket and e2e for sample change. Will cc Priya for sample verification.

Priya: thanks all. this one is small but high ROI for PLG. I'll update the sample README with recommended concurrency and a short note on Retry-After. :thumbsup:
